# Cloud App SDK archive

The scaffold pins the npm release `@tier0/sdk-v2@0.10.1`, downloaded unchanged
from `https://registry.npmjs.org/@tier0/sdk-v2/-/sdk-v2-0.10.1.tgz`.
It supplies platform, data, Stream request and real-time message APIs.

SHA256: `667e700c16f679b8284627a53fddc01a4092a277bca3652d91788c10ab5ab945`.
The lockfile records the published package integrity. Historical archives are
retained for provenance and are not installed. Updating the template does not
update existing Apps or establish live Backend compatibility.

SDK 0.10.1 targets Backend contract `07ef8cd30a5465a98c8e6ee0892d02360aee8761`.
Its bundled entry is `skills/tier0-sdk-v2/SKILL.md`, with 11 nested domain
Skills. Read these from the installed package, not a global older SDK Skill.
